title: Where the Capitation Dollar Goes: Los Angeles Medi-Cal Plans, 2010 to 2026
desc: The profit and loss of two Los Angeles Medi-Cal plans over sixteen years of DMHC financial filings: Health Net Community Solutions banked $5.42 billion running lean, while L.A. Care banked $2.50 billion spending nearly everything on care and never once dipping below the 85% medical loss floor. A published Tableau dashboard tracks net income, the floor, per member economics, and reserves, with every figure verified in DuckDB SQL and pandas across 54 checks.

title: The Price of a Member: Medi-Cal Capitation Rates in Los Angeles
desc: What the state pays Los Angeles health plans per adult member per month, 2021 to 2026: a steep 2022 cut, a sharp 2024 rebuild, and a county paid below the statewide average, with a what if dial that turns rate moves into revenue. Every calculation explained in DuckDB SQL and pandas across 149 checks.

title: Medi-Cal Market Share in Los Angeles, from Enrollment to Quality
desc: Who holds the Los Angeles Medi-Cal managed care market, how it tripled over 19 years, and whether the biggest plan is also the best. A published Tableau dashboard maps market share, penetration, quality, and provider access, with every calculation explained in DuckDB SQL and pandas across 18 assertions.

title: How Medicare Rates Health Plans, and Why the Heaviest Measures Decide the Score
desc: CMS scores every Medicare Advantage plan from 1 to 5 stars, but it does not average the measures, it weights them, so the heaviest measures decide the score. A published Tableau dashboard benchmarks, ranks, and rebuilds the ratings, and every calculation is explained in DuckDB SQL and pandas across 75 assertions.

title: Translating Tableau into SQL and pandas: Benchmarks, Table Calculations, and Parameters
desc: What Tableau silently does when you build a chart, shown line by line in SQL and pandas: FIXED benchmarks, table calculations, and a viewer controlled year parameter, each verified to the digit on a California Medi-Cal HEDIS plan quality scorecard published to Tableau Public.

title: How Tableau Thinks: LODs, Table Calcs, and Parameters Explained Through SQL and pandas
desc: Using SQL and pandas as the reference point to demystify what Tableau does to your data under the hood: FIXED, INCLUDE, and EXCLUDE LODs, table calculations, and parameters, each verified to the digit on 19 years of California Medi-Cal enrollment data.

title: Python Problem Patterns: pandas, numpy, and Python
desc: 24 pandas, numpy, and basic-Python patterns grouped into three families, each with signal words, a pattern template, three worked examples (Easy, Moderate, Hard), and common gotchas, plus a five-step diagnostic and interactive decision trees.

title: SQL Window Functions: A Practice Guide

title: Building an End-to-End dbt Pipeline on Snowflake: AirStats

title: Comparing A/B Testing Methods: When to Use Each Approach
desc: A practical guide to ten A/B testing methods — frequentist, sequential, Bayesian, CUPED, uplift modeling, and multi-armed bandits — with plain-language intros, worked example calculations, interactive decision tree, and a how-to-run-a-test process flow.

title: Product Analytics in Practice: An E-Commerce Case Study

title: How to Structure Product Analytics for Development and Rollout: A Practitioner's Framework
desc: A five-phase framework for product analytics — Discovery, Validation, Build, Rollout, and Scale — with deliverables, key metrics, analysis methods, warning signs, and a speaking outline for each phase.

title: Beyond Recall: How Business Loss Functions Change Which Model Wins

title: The Recall Precision Spectrum: A Side by Side Comparison of 15 Classification Models

title: SQL Problem Patterns: A Practice Guide

title: SQL Debugging & Code Review — PostgreSQL

title: Python & Pandas Debugging — Data Wrangling

title: dbt Cloud Debugging & Code Review

title: How to Say "The Data Doesn't Support That" Diplomatically

desc: Hyperparameter tuning and train/test splitting strategies with caret in R.
